availability.note: bydautomotive.com.au/configurator/sealion-6 301-redirects to BYD's VirtualYard configurator; on 2026-11-26 it lists exactly three grades: Essential $42,990, Dynamic Extended $46,990, Premium Extended $52,990. Dynamic Standard Range and Premium Standard Range (both in BYD's May 2026 brochure and CarExpert's 2026 review line-up) are no longer offered. CarExpert's 2026 model page also lists the same three variants.

listPrice.note: CarExpert spec page: 'prices starting at $42,990' before on-road costs (drive-away $47,182 Sydney shown separately); CarExpert 2026 review '$42,990 plus on-road costs'. BYD configurator shows $42,990 on 2026-11-26 with drive-away needing a postcode; $42,990 is below the computed Victorian drive-away ($45,676), so it is the list price.

batteryKwh.note: usable: EU Seal U DM-i 2026 leaflet (CZ) 'Kapacita baterie - vyuzitelna (usable) 18,3 kWh' for Boost (FWD, 160kW, same powertrain); CarExpert lists 18.3 usable / 18.32 max; AU brochure 18.3kWh.

rangeKm.note: EU Seal U DM-i Boost (FWD, 18.3kWh, 160kW, same powertrain as AU Essential) WLTP electric range combined 80km. AU brochure figure 92km is explicitly 'NEDC' (SOC 25-100%) and higher than WLTP, so rejected per direction test.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 18.3/80 = 22.875. EU leaflet's 19 kWh/100km and AU 169 Wh/km are label/weighted quantities, not used.

combinedRangeKm.note: 80 WLTP electric + 60L tank (AU brochure) / 5.6 L/100km x 100 = 80 + 1071.4 = 1151

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: Charge-sustaining WLTP: EU Boost 'Spotreba paliva - kombinovana 5,6 l/100 km', listed with low/medium/high CS phases and separate from the 2.2 weighted figure. Chosen over AU brochure 'SOC <25%' 4.72 (ADR 81/02, NEDC-based) for consistency with byd-shark-6 (WLTP CS). CarExpert measured 4.8 indicated starting from full charge.

insuranceAnnual.note: Kept held value. Anchored to jaecoo-j7-shs-summit ($42,990, 1600), geely-starray-em-i-complete ($37,490, 1500) and byd-sealion-5-premium ($37,990, 1320); BYD rows run lower than Chery-group rows at similar prices.

towKg.note: CarExpert spec page: 750kg braked, 750kg unbraked; EU Boost leaflet 750 braked.

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: BYD AU brochure 'Boot / Load Space Min (L) 425', all grades; CarExpert spec pages give 425L VDA to the window line (cargo-cover convention). Same figure on the EU Seal U leaflet for 18.3kWh cars.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: BYD AU brochure 'Boot / Load Space Max (L) 1,440', all grades; CarExpert lists 1,440L VDA seats down. Not stated whether to roof or belt line.

warrantyYears.note: 72 months/150,000km whole vehicle; battery 96 months/160,000km (in pros). Matches BYD reference value 6; BYD AU model page states 6 years/150,000km.

batteryKwh.note: AU brochure Premium Extended Range 26.6kWh; same Blade pack the EU leaflet (CZ) labels usable 26.6kWh on the Comfort.

rangeKm.note: No market sells this exact car (pre-facelift 253kW AWD + 26.6kWh): EU pre-facelift Design AWD has 18.3kWh; EU 2027 facelift Design AWD has 26.6kWh but a 275kW powertrain (WLTP 114km, DE brochure). Derived: AU NEDC 128km x WLTP/NEDC ratio of the AWD 18.3kWh pair (EU Design 70km WLTP / AU Premium Standard 81km NEDC = 0.864) = 110.6. Cross-checks: FWD ratios 0.870/0.893 give 111-114; facelift 26.6 AWD WLTP 114.

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm x 100 = 26.6/111 = 23.96; the 2027 facelift Design AWD 26.6kWh publishes 24.0 kWh/100km WLTP.

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: No WLTP charge-sustaining figure for this exact car. Scaled from AU brochure low-SOC figures: Premium Extended 'SOC <20%' 5.5 vs Premium Standard 'SOC <25%' 5.8 (NEDC), applied to EU pre-facelift Design AWD WLTP CS 7.1: 7.1 x 5.5/5.8 = 6.73. Equivalently AU 5.5 x the AWD WLTP/NEDC ratio 1.224. Sits with geely-starray-em-i-inspire-awd 6.7 and jaecoo-j7-shs-summit-awd 6.4; held value was 5.8.
